scope: Offline exploratory controlled-attack triage; never natural fraud probability or runtime promotion
priorExposure: Existing source/scenario partition and prior test samples have been inspected. New sampling seeds do not create a confirmatory untouched study.
split: Inherited provider partitions, cross-partition patients purged before sampling; calibration providers divided into tuning, probability, conformal, policy groups with further patient purging
primaryQuestion: Does the complete candidate reduce controlled-attack routing cost at a validation-selected review budget versus rules and retrained observable NB?
rivalExplanation: Rules encode the detectable injected conditions; context adds no observable signal for concealed compromise, and complexity only adds false routes.

promotion.decision: HOLD unless independent evidence and runtime input commitments are available
necessaryChecks: No higher mean controlled cost or lower mean recall than rules and NB
Paired provider bootstrap cost difference upper bound below zero
Conformal marginal coverage measured with assumptions disclosed
Phase 3 authenticated history commitments and regressions not yet implemented

componentPolicy.graph: Prior patient-provider graph only; no fabricated bank links or label-seeded suspicion propagation
componentPolicy.temporal: Date-resolution exponential Hawkes candidate fitted on training histories; exclude same-day events; no intraday claim
componentPolicy.ood: Regularized treatment-group covariance; diagnosis conditional only for groups with enough training support; explicit pooled fallback
componentPolicy.explanations: Native exact tree-path-dependent SHAP on raw margin, not calibrated-probability attribution
componentPolicy.quantization: Separate rounded export evaluated against reference; never silently substitute if routing differs
